issues.description: The template Main.java uses a call to farm.feed() (which does not exist), while the problem specification and the solution use the method name feedAllAnimals(). This mismatch between the sample usage in the template and the required API (UML and solution) can confuse students and cause a compilation error if they uncomment or follow the template Main usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Main.java to call farm.feedAllAnimals() (the method name used in the UML and solution) instead of farm.feed(), or add a feed() delegating method in Farm that calls feedAllAnimals() so the sample usage matches the specified API.

issues.description: The problem statement and solution specify a Farm method named feedAllAnimals(), but the template's Main uses farm.feed(); this inconsistent identifier for the same concept (feeding all animals) can confuse students about which method to implement or call.
